manifest.notes: Deterministic rules derived from data/regulations/excerpts.json. Condition nodes are a small safe DSL (no eval of stored code): {all:[...]} / {any:[...]} / {not:node} / {field, op, value}. Valid ops: eq, ne, in, not_in, gt, gte, lt, lte, contains. Evaluated against a fixed context: connectionModel, ownershipStatus, recommended_capacity_kw, gis_codes (set of GisFinding.code present).

rules.title: Self-consumption rooftop solar is a supported connection path
rules.title_template: Self-consumption connection is supported for this site
rules.explanation_template: Self-consumption solar is permitted for industrial facilities without a generation-capacity limit on export, since the system does not export to the grid. Roof ownership/authorization is confirmed for this assessment.
rules.authority: Demo National Electricity Regulatory Authority (DNERA) — fictional placeholder
requiredDocuments: Proof of roof ownership or landlord authorization letter

rules.title: Self-consumption connection needs ownership authorization on file
rules.title_template: Roof ownership/authorization must be confirmed before approval
rules.explanation_template: Self-consumption systems require the facility to hold roof ownership or written landlord authorization before the distribution company grants connection approval. This has not been confirmed for this assessment.
rules.authority: Demo National Electricity Regulatory Authority (DNERA) — fictional placeholder
requiredDocuments: Roof ownership deed or landlord authorization letter

rules.title: Net-metering capacity exceeds the program threshold
rules.title_template: Recommended capacity exceeds the net-metering threshold
rules.explanation_template: The net-metering program covers systems up to 20,000 kW per site. The recommended capacity exceeds this threshold and would need to apply under the separate independent-power-producer program instead.
rules.authority: Demo National Electricity Regulatory Authority (DNERA) — fictional placeholder

rules.title: Net-metering capacity within the program threshold
rules.title_template: Net-metering connection is supported for this capacity
rules.explanation_template: The recommended capacity is within the 20,000 kW net-metering threshold. A technical interconnection study is required before energization, typically 30-60 business days.
rules.authority: Demo National Electricity Regulatory Authority (DNERA) — fictional placeholder

rules.title: Protected-area intersection requires environmental clearance
rules.title_template: Site intersects a protected area; environmental clearance required
rules.explanation_template: The site intersects a designated protected area in the loaded GIS layer. An environmental impact assessment and written clearance from the environmental authority are required before any construction permit may be issued.
rules.authority: Demo National Electricity Regulatory Authority (DNERA) — fictional placeholder
